project_type: Next.js 15 App-Router PWA (mobile-first, offline-first) in strict TypeScript, backed by Firebase (Auth + Cloud Firestore + Storage). RSC-by-default with client islands for anything touching the Firebase Web SDK, Zustand, timers, charts, or browser APIs.
build_system: pnpm 9+ (installed: pnpm 12.9.1); Next.js 15 build (next build) + Turbopack/webpack per Next defaults; @ducanh2912/next-pwa wraps next.config and is DISABLED in dev, enabled on build. Node 20 LTS targeted (host currently reports v26 — treat Node 18.18+ as the floor).
test_framework: Vitest for unit/component tests (jsdom + @testing-library/react). Firebase Emulator Suite + @firebase/rules-unit-testing for optional, creds-independent rules/integration tests.
test_command: pnpm test  (= vitest run); scoped: pnpm vitest run <path>; rules (optional): pnpm test:rules
verification_instructions: After EVERY change, run: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck (= tsc --noEmit) && pnpm build (= next build). ALL must exit 0 with EMPTY/blank NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* env and nothing may throw at import/build time (NFR-1, AC-1). Run pnpm test for unit/component tests. Run pnpm test:rules against the Firebase Emulator Suite when available for the C.14 rules assertions; when the emulator is unavailable, record those as 'needs verification during implementation' rather than claiming done. Grep is NOT verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml is generated by pnpm install and MUST be committed. next-pwa generates public/sw.js + workbox-*.js on build (gitignored build artifacts; do not hand-edit). PWA icons under public/icons are committed assets. No other generated-then-committed files.
environment_constraints: NO real Firebase project and NO credentials exist, and none can be supplied; do NOT mock Firebase to fake success. The guarded lazy singleton (design C.2) must keep lint/typecheck/build green with absent env: no initializeApp() at import time, getters return null when config absent and never throw, client-only init via typeof window, services short-circuit to a typed ServiceResult error {ok:false, code:'firebase/not-configured'}. Code becomes fully functional the instant real NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* values are dropped into .env.local. .env.local is gitignored (blank placeholders); .env.local.example is committed. Firebase Emulator Suite may be unavailable in the sandbox; rules tests are then 'needs verification'.
contribution_requirements: Build directly in repo root /Users/abi-mac/Documents/Me/dev/gym on branch main (greenfield, NO git worktree). Commit locally per feature; never push. design.md is the authoritative contract; honor PART D/E/F resolved review findings EXACTLY. All Firestore/Storage/Auth access funnels through src/services/* calling src/lib/firebase/*; UI never imports firebase/firestore directly. Weights stored canonically in kilograms. Single authoritative profile at users/{uid}/profile/data (no mirror); preferredUnit only on UserProfile. User docs keyed by Firebase uid, never email.
key_patterns: ServiceResult<T> = {ok:true;data:T} | {ok:false;code:string;message:string} returned by every service, mapping raw Firebase errors to friendly code/message (FR-38). Typed Firestore via withConverter in src/lib/firebase/converters.ts; converters OMIT absent optional keys via conditional spread (never field: value ?? null) and the app sets ignoreUndefinedProperties:true. Firestore offline via persistentLocalCache + persistentMultipleTabManager. Timers use absolute endsAtMs/startedAtMs epoch anchors in timerStore (persist); elapsed recomputed as now-anchor, rAF only drives the visible tick. AuthGuard is a 6-phase state machine in authStore.phase (not-configured|initializing|authed-loading-profile|unauthenticated|onboarding|ready); only 'unauthenticated' redirects to /login, both loading phases render a full-screen loader with NO route change (no dashboard flash). Completed sessions are immutable (rules + services + conflictResolver); the only permitted post-completion mutation is the summaryApplied false->true merge toggle. Composite 'complete session' op = Step1 PR detection (reads before writes) + Step2 writeBatch gated on await waitForPendingWrites(db) + Step3 separate per-summary runTransaction keyed on summaryApplied. Single-doc idempotent writes go directly through the SDK with deterministic IDs; the custom syncQueue owns ONLY the composite complete-session op (orchestration/status, not transport). Pure libs (oneRepMax, units, volume, progression, analytics transforms, conflictResolver, converters, Zod schemas) are the highest-value Vitest targets. Heavy client islands (charts, calendar, PR celebration) are next/dynamic ssr:false with skeleton fallbacks.
